list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them
sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written for this entry in our own words from those descriptions; anything not verified in-game says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order, clear the missable trophies on sight, and leave the collectible cleanup for last, when free roam is fully open. If a trophy stalls, read its guide here rather than grinding blindly: the platinum is a checklist, not a skill test.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableReason: The opening mission only happens once, at the very start of the game.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so just play it through — the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Because it is the opening beat, do not skip the tutorial prompts on a first playthrough; the fishing mechanics taught here come back in later challenges.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A chapter ends when its final mission wraps, so keep playing the story missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter card. Side content can wait — nothing in Chapter 1 blocks the chapter trophy, and failed missions can be retried from the checkpoint.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The game's own completion checklist is the boss here: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the rest all feed the percentage, and the in-game stats screen shows what is still missing. Work it after the finale, using the checklist in this guide as the map, and the gold pops at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. A stunt is any jump, drift, near-miss or airtime the game scores — the counter climbs in normal play, so do not grind it early. Once the story is done, chain jumps and drifts on the highways and the total ticks up fast; the in-game stats screen shows your count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game counts nine activity types — fishing, shooting range, drone races, races, arcade, meditation, hunting, bowling and the rest — and the trophy pops when you have sampled all of them once. Tick them off one by one after the story; none of them needs a win, just a try.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the ranges; gold needs accuracy and speed, not just completion. Learn each range's weapon and target pattern, retry the ones you silver until they turn gold, and the trophy pops when the last one does.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Ten vehicles registered in the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, register it, repeat ten times — any ten vehicles count, so use the ones you already drive.
